PEAT GmbH - overview Established 2015 Location Berlin, -, Germany Primary Industry Software About PEAT GmbH is a technology company focused on enhancing agricultural practices through its innovative platform, Plantix, which aids farmers in diagnosing and treating crop diseases effectively. PEAT GmbH was formed in 2015 in Berlin, Germany, providing a mobile application that assists farmers in diagnosing crop diseases. The company has undergone strategic development since its inception and has raised funds through multiple rounds, culminating in a Series A round in April 2023, where it raised EUR 6. 60 mn led by RTP Global. The company was also recently acquired by Helm AG, with the acquisition details undisclosed. The founders include Bianca Kummer, Korbinian Hartberger, and Winson ??? , while the current CEO is Rahul Solanki. Plantix offers a robust platform designed primarily to assist farmers in diagnosing and treating crop diseases while enhancing their agricultural practices. The core service revolves around a user-friendly mobile application that allows users to capture images of affected crops, receiving near-instantaneous diagnoses and treatment recommendations. This service is tailored for individual farmers, agronomists, and agricultural experts within a global community, facilitating knowledge exchange and support among users. The app encompasses a comprehensive library of information regarding various plant diseases and prevention strategies, ensuring users are equipped to achieve successful harvests. Plantix's offerings are utilized across diverse geographical markets, including regions in Brazil, Spain, and Indonesia, contributing to its status as the most downloaded ag-tech application worldwide. Plantix generates revenue primarily through its app, which may operate under a freemium model, allowing users to access basic features while offering premium functionalities for enhanced services. Additionally, the company engages in partnerships with agri-retailers and agribusinesses, facilitating a business-to-business (B2B) structure that supports agricultural supply chains. Users can subscribe to premium content or features that provide advanced diagnostic tools and personalized consultations. With its extensive reach within the agricultural sector, users benefit from direct-to-consumer interactions and retail partnerships, making transactions seamless for farmers seeking effective crop health solutions. The company’s focus on delivering quality agricultural support through its flagship app, Plantix, positions it strategically within the ag-tech market. Following the acquisition by Helm AG in April 2023, PEAT GmbH plans to leverage the new ownership for further product development and geographic expansion. They aim to introduce new features in their application that enhance user experience and diagnostic capabilities. The company is also targeting expansion into new markets, focusing on regions in Asia and Africa by the end of 2024. Recent funding from the Series A round will support these initiatives, along with strengthening their existing operational framework to accommodate a larger user base.
